items.title: 구찌 모기업 케링 주가 16% 폭락으로 열린 명품 업계의 겨울
items.summary: Kering shares fell 16% on Oct 23 in their worst single-day drop ever after Gucci's Q3 sales fell 6%; Kering is accelerating restructuring with 125 store closures by year-end. The piece contrasts this with Korean department stores, where weak-won driven foreign tourist spending is hitting record highs (~1 trillion won/year), a 'decoupling' from the weak global trend.

items.title: 구찌 실적 부진에 케링 주가 16% 급락…LVMH·에르메스도 약세
items.summary: Reports Kering's 16% share plunge tied to Gucci's weak Q3, noting the sell-off dragged down LVMH and Hermès shares as well, reflecting broad investor anxiety about the luxury sector's China exposure and turnaround timeline under CEO Luca de Meo.

items.title: ケリング株が一時16%超の急落、第3四半期の「グッチ」の売上低迷と再建への不透明感
items.summary: Covers Kering's share collapse of over 16% intraday following Q3 results showing continued Gucci weakness and uncertainty about the pace of the brand's turnaround under new leadership, with Asia traffic cited as a persistent drag.

items.title: デムナの「グッチ」刷新が動き出す　ケリング第3四半期に見えた回復の兆し
items.summary: A more balanced read on the same Q3 print, arguing Kering's smaller-than-feared revenue decline and early signs of Demna-led creative execution and retail recovery show incremental progress even though Gucci sales are still falling.

items.title: ケリング、第3四半期売上高10%減と発表 グッチの不振がなお重し
items.summary: Trade-press report that Kering group-wide Q3 revenue declined on a reported basis with Gucci's continued underperformance cited as the primary drag, part of broader coverage of the stock's post-earnings slide.

items.title: Everyone in China recognizes Gucci. That's the problem
items.summary: Critical analysis arguing Gucci's near-universal brand recognition in China has become a liability: Q3 directly-operated sales fell 9% on weaker mainland traffic, and the piece contends the brand lacks a distinctive narrative to pull shoppers back beyond logo familiarity.

items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: Bernstein's senior luxury analyst Luca Solca scored Demna's debut 2026-27 FW Gucci show 7.6/10, calling it 'not a home run' that disappointed some media and buyers though less so than the previous designer; jackets and trousers passed muster but shoes and handbags were called boring, with leggings drawing particular criticism for looking cheap rather than sexy.

items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Reports Gucci began selling sneakers labeled 'Made in China' for the first time, a break with its Italian-manufacturing identity; Gucci says Italy remains central but the Chinese partner offered the best-suited technical capability, while some industry watchers warn the move could erode the brand's high-end image even as it tries to win back middle-class shoppers.

items.title: 럭셔리 시장 침체 언제까지…케링 3분기 매출 16% 감소
items.summary: Korean trade coverage of Kering's weak Q3 print framed as a broader question of how long the luxury downturn will last, citing Gucci's continued decline as the central drag on group results and investor confidence.

items.title: '구찌 부진' 케링 주가 10% 이상 급락, 2025년 6월 이후 최저
items.summary: Reports Kering shares falling more than 10% intraday to their lowest level since June 2025, directly attributing the move to continued Gucci weakness and investor skepticism about the recovery plan.

items.title: 케링 주가 16% 폭락…명품 업계 동반 부진
items.summary: Follow-up coverage of the Kering share rout, noting that peers across the luxury sector also weakened in sympathy, framing Gucci's struggles as emblematic of a sector-wide demand slowdown rather than an isolated brand problem.

items.title: グッチ"シルバーロゴ"のレザートートバッグ＆犬モチーフのコインケース、伊勢丹新宿店で
items.summary: Activation coverage: Gucci will sell Japan-exclusive women's accessories including a silver-logo leather tote and animal-motif coin cases at an Isetan Shinjuku pop-up running Nov 4-10; standard brand marketing coverage, included for channel-mix completeness and flagged as promotional in nature.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀+关店105家+中国制造，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: A templated FAQ-style Weibo commentary account post summarizing Gucci's 2026 upheaval: Demna's runway debut, 105 global store closures, first China-made sneakers and 30% price cuts, and CEO Francesca Bellettini's turnaround mandate. No visible like/comment/share counts; flagged as recurring farmed-content format common to this account, included only as directional buzz signal, not weighted as organic engagement.

items.title: 古驰国内和国外价差还有多少？2026降价后不足10%？3个维度算清该不该出国买
items.summary: Weibo consumer-advice post noting that after 2026's China price cuts, the domestic-vs-overseas price gap for Gucci has narrowed to under 10% (previously 30-50%), discussing whether it still makes sense for Chinese shoppers to buy Gucci abroad. Same templated-FAQ account style; no visible engagement counts.

items.title: 古驰和普拉达哪个档次高？3个维度讲透+FAQ
items.summary: Weibo post comparing Gucci and Prada positioning, citing Gucci's 2026 spring/summer price cuts of over 40% on some bags (e.g. Mercato small tote from 25,500 to 20,000 RMB) as part of the comparison; consumer-advice/FAQ account format, no visible engagement metrics shown.

items.title: Gucci又涨价了！热门手袋涨幅超10%，3个规律说清现在该不该入手
items.summary: A separate, contradictory Weibo thread claims Gucci raised prices on popular handbags by over 10% (citing the Horsebit 1955 medium shoulder bag rising ~10.9%), illustrating confused/conflicting consumer narratives online about whether Gucci is cutting or raising prices in China this cycle. Included for critical-angle balance; no visible engagement counts.

items.title: 新浪时尚热点小时报丨2026年10月30日04时_今日实时时尚热点速递|古驰|珍珠|造型|婚礼|晚宴
items.summary: Sina fashion-news-aggregation hourly digest bundling Gucci alongside other trending fashion topics (pearls, styling, weddings) for Oct 30, reflecting that Gucci remained part of the day's trending fashion-topic rotation on Chinese social feeds. No independently visible engagement metrics.

items.title: [다시, 보기] 구찌는 왜 경복궁을 고집했나…역설의 배설
items.summary: A theqoo community repost/discussion of a retrospective critical piece questioning why Gucci insisted on holding its Cosmogonie show at Gyeongbokgung Palace, revisiting the cultural-appropriateness debate around the venue choice; exact post date not visible on the page, retained as an active discussion thread on a Priority-A NEA community source.

items.title: 명품답지 못했다···구찌 경복궁 패션쇼, 경범죄 '심야 뒤풀이쇼' 눈살
items.summary: Background/reference item on the original Gyeongbokgung after-party noise controversy (police issued misdemeanor citations after 52 noise complaints); outside the 14-day freshness window, included only as context for the theqoo retrospective thread above, not counted as a fresh signal.

items.title: 연말 시즌 앞두고 명품 가격 'N차 인상'···"한국만 배짱장사" 비판 확산
items.summary: Critical consumer-angle piece on repeated year-end luxury price hikes across Hermès, Gucci, Louis Vuitton and others, amplifying consumer criticism that luxury houses practice 'arrogant markup' specifically in the Korean market without transparent notice.

items.title: Gucci's new Made in China sneaker breaks Italian tradition
items.summary: Wire coverage of the Gucci Drip sneaker's Made in China label, noting the move divides opinion online between consumers who see it as smart supply-chain pragmatism and others who worry it dilutes the brand's Italian-heritage premium positioning.

coverage.notes: Priority-A NEA sns/community sources (Weibo, Douyin, Naver Blog, Naver Cafe, Zhihu) were all site-scoped-searched this run. Weibo returned usable (if templated/farmed-style) commentary; Douyin returned only evergreen authentication/styling content with no date proximity to target window, excluded. Naver Blog and Naver Cafe returned no indexed Gucci-specific results via public web search this run (platform indexing limitation, not a content absence claim). Zhihu returned only evergreen reference content, excluded as non-fresh. DC Inside and FM Korea surfaced only generic/old community posts with no date markers close to 2026-11-01, excluded from the item pool but logged as checked.
